meta.source: Authored from the overseer README (no existing styles); first pass

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of the board; the terminal-like base everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: board columns, cards, the requirements table, dialogs.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: terminal output, code blocks, inputs, empty coverage segments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, columns and card sections. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons), hollow coverage segments. At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, sunken and every -soft ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and sunken: metadata, timestamps, asked-by, column counts.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg and surface only: placeholders, closed items (cancelled, rejected, obsolete). Never on sunken.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand hue. Primary button fill, focus ring, filled coverage segments, the verified state and doctor OK. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Text and links in the brand hue on bg, surface and signal-soft.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (primary button). Dark on the light teal of the Terminal theme, white on Paper.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for verified/delivered badges and the selected row; text on it is ink or signal-ink.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Lint warnings, drift, doctor WARN, likely-related duplicate hints. Text and icons on bg, surface and warn-soft. Always with the word, never color alone.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for lint notes and warn badges; text on it is ink or warn.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Bugs, errors (DISABLED, NO_PROJECT), doctor FAIL, duplicate verdicts. Text and icons on bg, surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for bug ID chips, error banners and duplicate hints; text on it is ink or danger.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the page colour.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The product name in plain type (there is no logo mark). Always lowercase.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title on the board: Board, Requirements, Coverage, an item page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Item title on its page; section headings in the Coverage view.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Field group headings: Links, Children, History.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: When a user requests a password reset, the system shall email a single-use link that expires after 30 minutes.
styles.usage: Descriptions, EARS statements, comments, dialog copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: asked by Ana · recorded by claude
styles.usage: Card titles, table cells, metadata lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers and field labels, uppercase. The only uppercase text in the system.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Item IDs, everywhere. IDs are never set in sans.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file paths, field names, status values in prose (in_progress).

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Rendered CLI output in docs, the README and the board's empty states.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label; inside ID chips (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding; gap between badges; coverage segment gap is half of this.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; table cell padding; gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between board columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; space between sections of an item page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top-of-page breathing room; dialog padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: ID chips, badges, coverage segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, terminal blocks. Nothing is rounder than this.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: a card while dragged, dialogs, menus. Resting surfaces use line, not shadow.
